trn.briefIntroduction_text: Common calcium compound./nWhen you look it up, in Japanese it is "炭酸カルシウム",/nin English it is "Calcium Carbonate"./nIt is the main component of chalk and is also used as an ingredient in antacids./nWhat is it used for, and why is it disguised as a person?/nThis mystery was finally uncovered by a clever boy, Con*** EDOgawa....../nOne truth prevails!!
